opportunities.description: Reduce unused JavaScript and defer loading scripts until they are required to decrease bytes consumed by network activity. [Learn how to reduce unused JavaScript](https://developer.chrome.com/docs/lighthouse/performance/unused-javascript/).

opportunities.title: Reduce unused CSS

diagnostics.title: Avoid enormous network payloads
diagnostics.description: Large network payloads cost users real money and are highly correlated with long load times. [Learn how to reduce payload sizes](https://developer.chrome.com/docs/lighthouse/performance/total-byte-weight/).

diagnostics.title: Minimize main-thread work

failed_audits.title: Legacy JavaScript
